answer: Rising-price registration: the nth wallet funded by one source within 20 epochs burns 1 + 0.01 x (n-1) POA. An honest newcomer pays 1 POA, while 1,000 fakes from one funder pay 1,000 + 0.01 x 499,500 = 5,995 POA, so the price climbs like a knoll into a summit. Routing money through a lotus of middle wallets fails, because the count follows the first funder in the transfer trail. Anyone can post that trail; a confirmed link reprices the cluster, the challenger gets half the extra burn, and a false claim loses 2 POA. Limit: waiting out the window.
